CustomField.description: Date until which the COLA Override Percent applies. If set to a future date, the override is used for multiple renewal cycles until this date. If left blank (null), the override applies to the next renewal only (one-time use).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter a future date to apply the COLA override for multiple renewal cycles until that date. Leave blank to apply the override for the next renewal only (one-time).
CustomField.label: COLA Override Persist Until
